channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Annihilated
item.description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

item.title: Ashes of the Singularity II
item.description: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

item.title: Backpack Battles
item.description: A PvP inventory management auto battler! Buy and craft powerful items, then carefully arrange them in your backpack.

item.title: Booster Pack Heroes
item.description: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.

item.title: Clustertruck
item.description: Clustertruck is a chaotic physics based truckformer. Jump your way through insane levels in a game of "the floor is lava" on top of speeding trucks driven by terrible drivers.

item.title: Darwinia
item.description: Darwinia blends real-time strategy, action, and puzzles with a unique gesture-based control system. Save the Darwinians, battle viruses, and restore order in a retro-inspired digital world. Winner of multiple prestigious awards, including the Seumas McNally Grand Prize at IGF 2006.

item.title: FEROCIOUS
item.description: Immerse yourself in a survival FPS adventure. Stranded on a dangerous island, face mercenaries, dinosaurs, and a vibrant yet hostile ecosystem. Explore breathtaking environments and survive the onslaught of intense, fast-paced encounters.

item.title: Icy Tower
item.description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

item.title: Music Manager
item.description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

item.title: SpiderHeck
item.description: Spiders with laser swords! Duel to the death against your friends or choose to team up and hold back swarms of savage enemies. Swing, stab and shoot with style, effortlessly performing movie-worthy parkour.

item.title: Warhammer Survivors
item.description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

item.title: World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24 Gold Edition
item.description: iRacing presents the Official Game of The World of Outlaws, featuring the World of Outlaws Sprint Car, Late Models and Super DIRTcar Big Block Modifieds, as well as 8 additional series including the all-new Micro Sprints, and many others.

item.title: Cinema Theater Tycoon
item.description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

item.title: Drill Core
item.description: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

item.title: Duke Nukem Forever
item.description: The King arrives with an arsenal of over-the-top weapons, giant explosions and pure unadulterated fun!

item.title: Evenicle - Next Fragment Medica
item.description: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!

item.title: For The King II: Dust to Dust Character Pack
item.description: Dig in and give your party a fighting chance with the Dust to Dust Character Pack!

item.title: For The King II: Fallen Oaths Character Pack
item.description: Strength and honor is at the forefront as we introduce two new playable characters - The Fallen Knight and the Voidwalker. These characters bring a host of new content to Fahrul, and beyond, to aid you in your journey - new weapons, a new trait, a new merc, and more!

item.title: For The King II: Into The Wild Character Pack
item.description: The Angler and The Beekeeper bring with them a menagerie of new content to For The King II - including two all-new weapon sets, a new trait, a new merc, a new pet, and a fantastic new cosmetic skin.

item.title: For The King II: Tinkerers Of Fate Character Pack
item.description: Bolster your adventures and renew the strength of The Resistance with the Tinkerers Of Fate Character Pack!

item.title: Go Next!
item.description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

item.title: iRacing Arcade
item.description: Race across global licensed series and build your own racing team to secure your motorsport legacy in this third person arcade racer.

item.title: iRacing® Studios NASCAR 26
item.description: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

item.title: Mortal Shell II
item.description: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

item.title: Neo Junk City
item.description: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

item.title: Oboro no Ichi
item.description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

item.title: ONE FENIX DOWN
item.description: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

item.title: Project Tomorrow
item.description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

item.title: Safari-TV
item.description: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.

item.title: Signs of Life
item.description: Signs of Life is a sci-fi survival sandbox platformer you can play alone or with friends in online co-op multiplayer. Explore a procedurally generated world, discover hand-crafted locations, and uncover the story of the life that was here before you.

item.title: Takeover 2
item.description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

item.title: Waifu Curator
item.description: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying 420 collectible figures made up of over 3,600 scattered pieces. Organize every collection and bring the ultimate waifu exhibition to life!

item.title: What the Buck?!
item.description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

item.title: Worst Class Ever
item.description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.
